adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` line and all `category_id` handling are removed, so existing invocations using `-c/--category` will now fail with an unknown option (a backward-incompatible CLI change). The import logic also changes from `PostCreator.new(... raw: "[[Permalink](...)]" ...)` to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)`, and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` performs `open(url).read`, meaning it will issue an HTTP fetch for each thread link (previously it did not fetch remote content). The claim about being "undocumented in the PR description" is not verifiable from the diff, but the behavioral changes above are directly present.
